name: codex-collab
description: Share a Codex task, coordinate trusted members, and protect concurrent file edits.

interface.shortDescription: A shared control room for one Codex task.
interface.longDescription: Pair a web room to the owner's local Codex, import visible task records, reasoning summaries, command output, project text and separately authorized non-credential .codex configuration, then forward approved prompts and protect edits with hashes.
defaultPrompt: Create a Codex Collab session for this project.
Pair this Codex host to the room and publish this project's tasks.
Bind this Codex task to the active collaboration session.
